info.name: NoteBerg
info.summary: Handwritten and typed notes with Nextcloud sync
info.description:
NoteBerg is a note-taking app combining handwriting, rich text, and Nextcloud sync.
## Features
### Handwriting & Drawing - Handwriting input with active stylus and pressure sensitivity - Pen tool with customizable colors, marker/highlighter tool - Lasso selection — move, resize, rotate, copy selected strokes - Eraser tool, unlimited undo/redo - Mark handwritten notes as tasks
### Text Editing - Rich text editor (WYSIWYG) with formatting, tables, colors, and font sizes - Automatic mode switching between drawing and text editing - Task checkboxes inline with notes
### Media & Import/Export - PDF import — annotate PDFs with pen and text - Image insertion with cropping and perspective correction - PDF export with automatic A4 pagination
### Organization - Notebooks for hierarchical organization - Note overview with thumbnail previews - Full-text search across handwriting and typed text - Markers tab — browse task markers across all notes - Recycle bin with soft delete and permanent deletion
### Sync & Storage - Offline-first — all data stored locally in IndexedDB - Nextcloud sync via WebDAV with conflict resolution
### UI - Dark mode / light mode with system preference detection - Background patterns — ruled lines and grid - Internationalization — English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Chinese
### Handwriting Recognition - Optional AI recognition with a vision model you configure yourself — off by default, always started manually. - Nothing is sent anywhere unless you turn it on and supply your own provider details. - When you start a recognition, your handwriting is rendered as an image and sent from your Nextcloud server to the endpoint you configured, and the transcribed text is returned. - The request is made by the server rather than the browser, so your API key stays on the server and is never exposed to the web page. It is stored encrypted.
### AI Integration (optional) - A shared, off-by-default AI provider connection (endpoint, model, API key) configured once per account in the app's settings. There is no built-in or shared service, and no key ships with the app. - AI handwriting recognition (above) is the first feature built on this connection, with more planned.
### Data & Privacy - All note data is stored exclusively on your own Nextcloud server — no third-party services or telemetry, except for the optional AI recognition described above, which is off unless you configure it - Note: uninstalling this app does not delete your note data from the server. Your notes remain in the /NoteBerg/ WebDAV folder and can be re-accessed by reinstalling the app. This is intentional — your data may also have been synced there by the NoteBerg desktop or mobile app.
### Also available on other platforms - Android: native app via Google Play open testing: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=eu.noteberg.app - Windows: desktop installer from GitHub Releases: https://github.com/thomasleuthold/NoteBerg/releases (unsigned build; Windows may warn about an unknown publisher)
info.author: Thomas Leuthold
